cross_product_finding: This page confirms, with real content, the contrast its Capella twin (cloud/search/create-search-index-ui.json, similarity 0.61) predicted from absence alone. The twin's notable_absence said it 'cannot tell from the text alone whether Capella's Search Service genuinely dropped this role gate or it is simply undocumented' against 'the server/ counterpart of this exact page, which explicitly requires the Search Admin role' - this page is that server counterpart, and it does state exactly that ('Your user account has the Search Admin role for the bucket where you want to create the index'), while Capella's version states no role requirement of any kind. Two further, previously-unrecorded divergences beyond that role gate: (1) this server page links to [Create a Basic Search Index Quickly](create-quick-index.md) (the 'Quick Editor') as a faster alternative path - the Capella twin has no Quick Editor equivalent and does not mention one; (2) the Capella twin links to search:set-advanced-settings ('Add and Configure Advanced Settings on a Search Index') as an explicit optional step in its own procedure, a page/action this server page never mentions at all, routing advanced configuration only through the generic customize-index.md link instead. All three divergences (role gate, Quick Editor, advanced-settings step) point the same direction: the Capella UI flow for this exact task is measurably thinner/different from the server Web Console flow it was matched against, not a near-duplicate as the raw 0.61 similarity score alone might suggest for a lower-divergence pair in this batch.
